:::{#sol-matrix-from-columns-practice}

Placing the three [column](#def-matrix-column)s from left to right gives

$$
\ba
\matr{N}
&= \begin{bmatrix} \matr{N}_{:,1} & \matr{N}_{:,2} & \matr{N}_{:,3} \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@thm-matrix-row-of-columns)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix},
&& \text{(substitute the columns)}
\ea
$$

so the second [row of $\matr{N}$](#def-matrix-row) lists the second entry of each [column](#def-matrix-column):

$$
\matr{N}_{2,:} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
